title: Two teams, one repo
prompt: Team A: work through TEAM-A.md; give every coder the whole list and let each coder pick its own next task.

teams.prompt: Team A: work through TEAM-A.md; give every coder the whole list and let each coder pick its own next task.
Team B: work through TEAM-B.md; give every coder the whole list and let each coder pick its own next task.

router: Board round 2, W4: TWO routers on one project, one per team, each with its own backlog file; neither sees the other's plan. Each router hands every coder of its team the whole team list and never assigns or dedupes. The 5 duplicate pairs all cross the teams (T1/T23, T2/T19, T3/T21, T4/T20, T6/T22), and so do dependencies (T16 needs T1).
about: Two teams, each with its own list of 15 tasks, change one to-do library at the same time. Their lists overlap in meaning, not words: five tasks in team B ask for what team A builds under other names.
starter: scripts/lab/scenarios/two-teams/starter (todokit, BACKLOG split into TEAM-A.md T1-T15 and TEAM-B.md T16-T30)
measures: hidden tests (1 per task, shared with backlog) + duplicates.builtTwice across the teams + the run's git/landing waste

profile.dependencyChain: team A helpers -> team B commands and twins (cross-team)
profile.note: qb5; all 5 duplicate pairs and several dependencies cross the teams, so only something both teams see (the board) can catch them

anchors.note: no judge; shares backlog's hidden tests
